name: The Grimm Forest
summary: Family of pigs race to build three houses by secretly choosing gathering spots and using fable tricks.
rules_text: Each round has Gather then Build. In Gather, each player secretly chooses one Gather location card (Fields=Straw, Forest=Wood, Brickyard=Brick, Market in 4p) and may play a Fable card face down. Reveal and resolve Fable When Revealed effects in turn order, placing any Monster miniatures. Reveal Gather cards and move pigs. If alone at a location, take all Single and Mega resources there; if multiple pigs share, divide equally rounding down, leftover stays. Resolve End of Gather Fables, discard them and return Monsters. In Build, in turn order each player takes two actions: draw a Fable, gain 1 resource of choice, or Build a house section paying its specific resource type. Houses must be built Floor then Walls then Roof. You cannot have two unfinished houses of same type, and you have 5 build sites. Building Walls lets you draw a Friend card; you may keep it or force it on another player, max one Friend each with a once-per-turn special action. First player to complete any three houses in any combination wins immediately.
rating_reason: Secret location picks to gather resources, hidden simultaneous choice and bluffing.
